levels.surface: عثمان ابن محمد ابن أبي شيبة

notes: «|» separates two routes in the source's chain field; «سمعته أنا من» names the compiler (rule 13) and is not written; «جدتي ربيعة ابنة عياض» and «جدي عبيدة ابن عمرو الكلابي» are relation words with a name, so each surface is the name alone (rule 7); the matn's «سمعت جدي عبيدة» is written once after both routes, so it is the shared tail
